A COMPLETE REMEDIAL SCOPE

Keep the work
under one crew.

From strip-out to the final seal, Hydro-Tec brings together the trades behind the restoration: screeding, waterproofing, tiling, concrete repair, joint sealing and protective coatings.

The focus is on larger remedial projects where diagnosis, coordination and a documented handover are part of the job.
